title: Normalized decomposition and adjunction data for ordinary finite projective lines
statement: For a commutative ring A of universe u+1, a natural number N, hA:(N:A)=0, and schemes of universe u [def-pc-scheme], work in the ordinary etale unbounded module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Fix a normalized transport system and the canonical arrows and functor G_q of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows], with the scalar Kummer class and derived-class realization of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class]. A normalized datum at a scheme S with N invertible consists of: invertibility on P=ProjectiveLine(S); a derived class c:A_P -> A_P(1)[2] whose abelian realization is the actual scalar Kummer class of O(1); an isomorphism b:A_S(1)[2] direct-sum A_S ~= Rq_* A_P(1)[2] whose hom is the coproduct of the shifted twisted unit and the adjunct h of c; the equation h then b.inverse then pr_2 = identity; an adjunction Rq_* left-adjoint G_q; and, for every unbounded K, the actual counit normalization pi then counit_K = (1 tensor (b.inverse then pr_2)) then the canonical constant-coefficient tensor right unitor. Define the trace to be b.inverse then pr_2. For a family of such data on Noetherian schemes with N invertible, define base-change compatibility to be three commutative squares for the decomposition, trace and actual counit, for every morphism between such bases; use exactly the exchange, shifted line/unit pullbacks, tensor pullback and G_q comparison of the canonical arrows node.
